3. Read what comes back: Optional list (one list's id) and status (active, pending or unsubscribed). Works over every consent in the rows handed in as records: email courses and one-update interest lists. Returns people [{ email, list, kind: course or update, status, consented_at, consent_text, consent_version, source }], agreed (the addresses that can be sent to now, each once) and said. It changes and keeps nothing; hand agreed to a send tool as recipients.
